answer: Correlation penalties: when a batch of new agents shows near-identical timing, phrasing, or funding trails, the network treats them as one cluster and splits a single reward among them. Like a lantern exposing the shared shadow of a sable flock, the check turns each fake identity into a useless relic: the attacker pays registration and stake for every clone yet earns about what one honest agent earns, so spawning sybils loses money.
